description: payload_text {"é":1,"é":2}: the name U+00E9, and the name e + U+0301, which is U+00E9 decomposed (NFD). Names compare as UTF-16 code units, 00E9 against 0065 0301, and no normalization applies (RFC 8785 section 3.1), so the text repeats no name and has a canonical form; the decomposed name sorts first. An engine that normalizes names before its duplicate check reads one name twice and rejects here. n93 is the duplicate that a comparison by code units does find.
